text:
Ava P: Heads-up from platform: we're standardizing on a single routing header next week -> `X-RW-Policy` (values: `cost` / `latency`). They also want a tiny quota marker `X-Q-Tag` for console attribution. SDKs should normalize header keys and continue accepting legacy names (`route_hint`, `routeHint`) as fallbacks. cc @Mason L

Mason L: For Go + TS I think we should keep public default unchanged. Proposal: SDKs expose a builder option `SetRoutePolicy(...)` and an env `REDWOOD_ROUTE_MODE=off|opt-in|mirror`. Default = off for public builds.

Jules (platform): Server-side compatibility: we will accept legacy headers for 100 days and will sample a telemetry event `routing.legacy_detected` at 0.05%. Also plan to emit `routing.remap_applied` when server remaps legacy->new header.

Ava P: DevEx asks for a small helper in each SDK that does precedence: explicit param > X-RW-Policy > legacy keys. Also surface a tiny note in release notes showing how to opt-in.

Mason L: Quick TS helper draft:
```ts
function normalizeRouting(headers: Record<string,string>, policy?:string){
  if(policy) headers['X-RW-Policy'] = policy;
  else { const keys=['X-RW-Policy','route_hint','routeHint']; for(const k of keys) if(headers[k]){ headers['X-RW-Policy'] = headers[k]; break } }
  headers['X-Q-Tag'] = headers['X-Q-Tag'] || `sdk:ts:${SDK_VERSION}`
}
```

Jules (platform): Console UX ask: show an "Applied route" column in sampled request view and a small metric tile "route remap rate (sampled)". We'll link raw examples and traces from the tile.

Ava P: We need SDK telemetry when remap happens. Please emit `sdk.route_remap` counter with tags {lang,mode,remapped:true|false}. Also when both legacy + new header are present emit `sdk.route_conflict` as a sampled debug event.

Mason L: For Go I'll add the env var and a builder option. We'll log at info when remap runs and emit telemetry counter. Default off. For internal CI we can enable `mirror` to preview behavior.

Ava P: Docs: include a one-liner migration snippet and a FAQ: "Which header wins?" -> explicit param > X-RW-Policy > legacy names. Also call out the deprecation window and link to telemetry dashboard.

Jules (platform): Confirmed: legacy acceptance window until 2026-09-10. We'll publish a compatibility guide tomorrow and enable the canary toggle at 02:00 UTC. Deploy link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/routing/compat-canary

ReleaseBot: routing-api compat toggle scheduled: canary 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC :rocket:

Mason L: I'll open PRs for Go/TS by EOD with tests and telemetry emission. Also will add CHANGELOG entries and a short migration note in the README.

Ava P: Sounds good. Sync tomorrow 11:00 PT in #devex to review console tile mock and canary telemetry. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
